text_block_list.text:
Beneath the blazing rays of the sun,
this year's summer training camp began.
As I immediately began unpacking my things—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
That picture book...
Is it *Wise King Moss and the Radiant Banquet*?
choice_data_list: はい、この夏一読しておきたく

text_block_list.text:
It was an entry from the picture book series about
'Wise King Moss,' the figure Rose Kingdom had once held
as the embodiment of the ideal monarch.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Those fangs and claws could shatter mountains,
and that wisdom surpassed even the greatest of sages.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Possessing overwhelming power to cut through adversity.
A presence who brings hope to the people all on his own.
That is the wise King Moss.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: It is my origin, and my ideal.

The night I heard about it from her, I purchased the entire picture
book series and read through it. Even so, I wished to read it
carefully once more.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see. Thank you.
This story remains especially close to my heart.
choice_data_list: どのあたりが、お心に残ったのですか

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Perhaps that is where one can sense Moss's strength and devotion to his people.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Sometime after founding the kingdom,
the wise King Moss would suddenly plan a grand banquet.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The sudden announcement left those around her bewildered,
wondering why such a thing was necessary now, of all times.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Even so, Moss paid no heed, directing the banquet entirely alone.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And so the grand banquet commenced—
Moss laid out a feast in the square, played music,
and kept the festivities roaring late into the night.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And so, they each would say:
"My heart has grown brighter."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, the people's hearts had grown
a little weary from the uncertain days ahead
in this new kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
All on their own, Moss healed
everyone's hearts and brought them together as one.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I believe it was only possible because you understand the hearts of the people so well.
It is by that strong, gentle radiance that everyone is guided.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I want to be like that, too.
That was what I thought in my childhood heart.
choice_data_list: 左様でございましたか……

text_block_list.text:
The influence the Wise King Moss had on Rose Kingdom
may be far greater than I thought.
choice_data_list: 今一度、熟読いたします

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I encourage you as well to deepen your understanding
of that king's tale.
